title: Kooky Grassy Argentinian Redcurrant Empanadas
description: A vegetarian Argentine dish featuring redcurrants and a long-fermentation dough, perfect for adventurous eaters. This empanada combines the sweetness of redcurrants with the earthiness of grassy herbs.

ingredients.name: grassy herbs like parsley or dill

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt.
Add olive oil, chopped grassy herbs, onion, and garlic to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 2 hours.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch and cut out circles of dough.
Place a spoonful of redcurrants in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve the empanadas warm or at room temperature.
